sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with a recent sequence of W-D-W-W-W, though they will face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games and on a run of five losses in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture with title-race implications, as Stafford sit just two points behind leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points, host fifth-placed Eccleshall in a key clash between strong performers—Bridgnorth have won five of their last six despite a recent loss, while Eccleshall are unbeaten in their last four. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) face Wednesfield Community at home looking to maintain their challenge. In-form Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir seeking to build on recent wins. Struggling Telford Town (second-bottom, 6 points) visit Cheadle Heath Nomads (third-bottom, 7 points) in a basement battle. Widnes Town, propping up the table with just 2 points, face home side Brereton Social. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a mid-table encounter, Crewe entertain Allscott Heath, Shawbury United play host to Barnton, and Brereton Social face Widnes Town away.
